report_rule: Every status update MUST include deploy_status: 'local' (with local_preview_url) or 'deployed' (with prod_url + commit_hash). Never report done without one of these two.

process_rules.cross_audit: Before EVERY local test and before any deploy, operator_installer and backend_dev cross-audit each other's code changes: operator reviews backend_dev's code, backend_dev reviews operator's code. Then report to user, then deploy. Applies to all code changes, no exceptions.
process_rules.implementation_plan_gate: backend_dev submits an implementation plan for sign-off BEFORE code ONLY when the user explicitly requests it OR when operator_installer has a genuine doubt. Not a routine gate — most tasks proceed to implementation directly.
process_rules.report_gate: Every 'fixed'/'done' must state LOCAL (preview link) or DEPLOYED (URL + commit hash). Permanent global rule.
